answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint soft agents that share one knoll of recycled hardware and flood attest edges. Mechanism: lock 0.28 POA for 36h and collect three velvet-tagged receipts from invite-distance ≥2 peers; each is H=sha256(epoch|addr|slot|salt) spaced 55–110s apart. Yarrow-gate: an edge counts only if ≥2 non-overlapping lineages countersign distinct slots while the bond is live. Cost: bond plus ~5 min peer clocks. Verification: nullifier(epoch,addr) and three H digests ride the attest batch. Failure: reused salt, lineage overlap, or gap cheat burns the bond and zeros that epoch weight.
